title: Inject the provider-run port into Foundation attempt settlement
description: Production prerequisite for parent task-a9c1fe620d2642cba3e3669a17ea1eac. Measured gap: createFoundationAttemptService is the served foundation.dispatch writer that commits EffectActivationCommitted and the PROVEN FoundationAttemptRecorded row consumed by goal qualification, but it hard-wires launchActivationProviderRun. Consequently a deterministic goal-closure control must either launch a real external provider or bypass the served writer; the current untracked tests/security/goal-closure-verification-fixture.ts takes the forbidden bypass and must not be adopted. Add a typed provider-run dependency port while preserving the real launcher as the default. Exact owned paths (3): apps/daemon/src/work/foundation-attempt-provider-port.ts; apps/daemon/src/work/foundation-attempt-service.ts; apps/daemon/src/work/foundation-attempt-service.test.ts.
